product_family: Consumer photo and face editing application with AI-powered filters and retouching tools. Flagship product: FaceApp mobile app available on iOS and Android. No enterprise or team-tier variants.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 on vendor's public website, privacy policy, or terms of service.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 on vendor's public website, privacy policy, or terms of service.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27001 or formal security management system certification on vendor's public website.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy claims compliance with GDPR mechanisms: 'Standard Contractual Clauses for cross-border transfers' and 'appointed a Data Protection Officer and a UK representative (VeraSafe)'. However, no formal GDPR certification audit or verification is documented. GDPR is a regulation (not a cert), and the vendor claims compliance measures but provides no third-party audit evidence.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. FaceApp is a consumer photo editing app with no healthcare-related features or data collection. No mention of HIPAA in terms or privacy documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of ISO 27017. While FaceApp processes data on Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services, the vendor does not claim compliance with cloud-specific security standards.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of PCI DSS. FaceApp handles subscription billing but does not claim PCI compliance on public documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy explicitly states: 'We do not use photographs or videos you provide when you use the Apps for any reason other than to provide you with the editing functionality.' No indication of using customer photos for AI model training or improvement.
privacy.data_region: Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services (no specific regional specification provided; international transfers mentioned with Standard Contractual Clauses)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Photographs and videos temporarily cached on cloud servers during editing; encrypted using key stored locally on user's mobile device

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Encryption key resides on user's device; vendor states 'we cannot disclose such content' because key is not stored server-side

security.name: Data Retention
security.value: Photos and videos automatically deleted within 24-48 hours after last edit. Users can request immediate removal via app settings.

security.name: Cloud Infrastructure
security.value: Cloud processing uses Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services; no specific regional details or SLA commitments documented

security.name: General Security Posture
security.value: Vendor claims they 'use commercially reasonable security practices to help keep the information collected through our services secure' but explicitly disclaims: 'we cannot guarantee the security of any information you provide.'

security.name: Third-Party Security Audits
security.value: No mention of penetration testing, security audits, or third-party verification on public documentation

security.name: Data Protection Officer
security.value: Data Protection Officer appointed and contact information available; UK GDPR representative designated (VeraSafe)

products.name: FaceApp
products.data_scope: Facial photos and metadata; temporary processing only (24-48 hour retention)
products.notes: 1 billion+ downloads. Available on iOS and Android. Offers free tier with ads and optional FaceApp Pro subscription. Single-product vendor; no enterprise variants.

compare.data_residency: Multi-cloud (Google Cloud Platform and Amazon Web Services); no specific regional residency guarantee

flags: No trust center or dedicated security documentation page (404 on /security URL)
No formal compliance certifications despite 1B+ user base; claims GDPR compliance mechanisms (DPO, SCC) but no audit evidence
Privacy policy uses broad language: 'license to use, reproduce...modify, adapt, create derivative works from' user content; though restricted to providing editing services
No third-party security audits, penetration testing results, or SOC 2/ISO certifications documented
Data processing on third-party cloud providers (GCP, AWS) but no transparency into those providers' compliance posture in FaceApp's documentation
International data transfers claimed but no specific regional details or SLA commitments documented
Explicit disclaimer: 'we cannot guarantee the security of any information you provide' is unusually strong liability waiver for a vendor with massive consumer user base
